submission.justification: Absorber-F1 with 4mm plate thickness is recommended as it achieves the best energy resolution of 3.224% at 100 GeV while meeting all safety constraints. This configuration outperforms Absorber-F3 (3.787% at 6mm) and significantly exceeds Absorber-F2 (5.07% at 4mm). The systematic thickness scan from 2-10mm confirmed that 4mm is optimal for F1, balancing sampling frequency and shower development. All three materials passed the critical dose rate requirement of ≤20 µSv/h at 1m after one week of cooldown, making F1 safe for hands-on maintenance while delivering superior detector performance.
